# gitmoap_ai_gate (Data Source)

One gate: the exact action it waits on, who may decide it, and its decision. Shown to its approvers, the board and anyone who can read the session that raised it; to anyone else it is not found.

The token needs `ai_org:read`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "gate_id" {
  type = string
}

data "gitmoap_ai_gate" "example" {
  gate_id = var.gate_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gate_id` (String) The gate

### Read-Only

- `agent` (Attributes) Who did something — a person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — with what a
client needs to draw and link them, so a page of records names its actors without a lookup each. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent))
- `approvers` (Attributes List) The people who may decide it besides the board. Empty means the organization's board, as it
is when the gate is decided. A `ritual_outcome` gate whose ritual names no approvers lists
the board as it was when the gate was raised. A member of the board may decide any gate. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--approvers))
- `body` (String) The exact text the decision is about, for the gates that carry one: what an
`external_message` write would publish, the title and description a `create_work_item` gate
would create, and the digest of a `ritual_outcome` gate's outcome.
- `consumed_at` (String) When the approved action was taken.
- `decide_by` (String) When it expires if nobody decides it.
- `decided_at` (String) When it was decided.
- `decided_by` (Attributes) Who did something — a person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — with what a
client needs to draw and link them, so a page of records names its actors without a lookup each. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--decided_by))
- `decision_note` (String) What the person who decided it wrote for the agent.
- `kind` (String) A kind of action an organization's autonomy decides whether an agent may take without asking.
- `org_id` (String)
- `requested_at` (String) When it was raised.
- `ritual_run_id` (String) A ritual run's id: one occurrence of one of an AI organization's rituals.
- `root_group_id` (String)
- `session_id` (String)
- `state` (String) Where a gate stands: waiting for a decision, approved or denied, spent by the action it
approved, lapsed undecided, withdrawn with its session, or — for a gate set to notify — a record
that the agent went ahead and people were told.
- `subject` (Attributes) The exact action a gate waits on, as it is stored and served. `action` says which, and decides
the other fields. Every action also carries `summary`, one line for the person deciding, and
`address`, what it is about, when it has one. A list longer than 50 is cut to 50 and ends with a
line saying how many more there were.

`action` says which applies: `merge`, with `address`, `merge_request_iid`, `repository_id`, `source_sha`, `summary`, `target_branch`, `target_sha`; `open_merge_request`, with `address`, `repository_id`, `source_branch`, `source_sha`, `summary`, `target_branch`; `create_work_item`, with `address`, `body_digest`, `scope_id`, `summary`; `close_work_item`, with `address`, `issue_uid`, `summary`; `release`, with `address`, `repository_id`, `summary`, `tag`, `target_sha`; `deploy`, with `address`, `environments`, `repository_id`, `sha`, `summary`; `privileged_push`, with `address`, `branch`, `from_sha`, `paths`, `repository_id`, `summary`, `to`; `add_dependency`, with `address`, `branch`, `dependencies`, `from_sha`, `repository_id`, `summary`, `to`; `external_write`, with `address`, `body_digest`, `method`, `path`, `summary`; `session_spend`, with `address`, `session_id`, `step`, `summary`; `ritual_outcome`, with `address`, `outcome_digest`, `run_id`, `summary`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--subject))

<a id="nestedatt--agent"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agent`

Read-Only:

- `avatar_url` (String) The principal's picture, when one is known. Absent otherwise: a client derives the
deterministic avatar URL itself.
- `email` (String) The principal's address. An agent's is a generated no-reply address — the author of its
commits. `unknown` on a deleted actor and empty on a redacted one.
- `id` (String) The principal's id: a user id, a service account id or an agent id, as `kind` says. Empty on
a redacted actor.
- `kind` (String) A person, a service account or an AI organization's agent — which of the three a principal is,
and so which page it links to: a person's profile, a service account's page or an agent's page.
- `username` (String) The name to show: a person's or service account's username, or an agent's handle (which
always ends in `-ai`). `deleted-user` when the actor no longer resolves, `redacted` when the
caller may not see who it was. A closed account whose work stays is `closed-` and twelve hex
digits, a shape no open account may take, with an address under `.invalid`.

<a id="nestedatt--subject"></a>
### Nested Schema for `subject`

Read-Only:

- `action` (String)
- `address` (String) What it is about.
- `body_digest` (String) The SHA-256 of the title and description, which the approval binds.
- `branch` (String) The branch.
- `dependencies` (List of String) The dependencies added, each as `manifest:name`.
- `environments` (List of String) The environments, each as `environment:tier`.
- `from_sha` (String) The commit it moves from.
- `issue_uid` (String) The work item.
- `merge_request_iid` (Number) The merge request's number in the repository.
- `method` (String) The request's method.
- `outcome_digest` (String) The SHA-256 of the outcome, which the approval binds.
- `path` (String) The request's path.
- `paths` (List of String) The privileged paths the change touches.
- `repository_id` (String) The repository.
- `run_id` (String) The run.
- `scope_id` (String) The repository or group it would be filed in.
- `session_id` (String) The session.
- `sha` (String) The commit it deploys.
- `source_branch` (String) The branch it opens from.
- `source_sha` (String) The source head the approval is for.
- `step` (Number) Which multiple of the alert it reached.
- `summary` (String) One line for the person deciding.
- `tag` (String) The tag.
- `target_branch` (String) The branch it merges into.
- `target_sha` (String) The target's head the approval is for.
- `to` (String) What it moves to: a pushed tip, or a web commit's tree.
